proved: commit-critical task remains strongly owned independently of client/SSE consumer lifetime
normal completion removes task from registry
task exceptions are explicitly observed by the registry
graceful bounded drain waits for a finishing commit task
drain timeout cancels remaining tasks only after the bounded wait
registry rejects new commit tasks after shutdown drain begins
safety_dependency: Cancellation after drain timeout is only replay-safe when V22 pre-provider durable intent tombstones are already integrated. Without V22 a hard/forced cancellation after remote provider progress can still leave no durable record.
integration_order: streaming Responses must submit commit-critical work to this registry rather than a generator-owned task
shutdown must drain this registry before closing account_pool
V22 intent publication must precede provider access so a timeout cancellation leaves a durable uncertain marker
do not emit provider-derived SSE content or IDs before final durable publication
